newsitem.title: AUSTRIA: Semperit 5-mth pretax profit soars 55 pct.
newsitem.headline: Semperit 5-mth pretax profit soars 55 pct.

text.p: Austrian rubber products maker Semperit AG Holding said on Wednesday group pretax profit in the first five months of the year surged 55 percent to 85 million schillings.
Group sales jumped nine percent to 1.4 billion schillings from the year-ago period, the company said in a statement.
Late on Tuesday, Semperit announced the price for its new issue of ordinary shares at 750 schillings per share with a nominal 100 schillings. The shares go on sale from June 16 through to June 30.
With the new issue of 326,562 shares, Semperit raises its base capital by 32.656 million schillings to a nominal 293.906 million schillings. -- Vienna newsroom, +431 531 12256
